html.description: The playground page as an HTML FRAGMENT (no doctype/html/head/body/style/link/script/footer). Must include the playground state widget carrying state='playgroundDinamicState' and one card per example.

examples.description: At least 6 distinct scenarios. Each example's state feeds the playground state; its key is what the page binds with {{playground.<key>.<property>}}.

name.description: Short scenario name, also the state key (camelCase, e.g. 'loading', 'noIcon').

state.description: State entries for this scenario. Empty when the scenario needs no state.
